sections.overview: A Brazilian catfish recorded from the Paraíba do Sul and Jequitinhonha basins.
sections.identification: It is one of six recognized Steindachneridion species; the genus revision describes several characters shared by its members.
sections.ecology: It shares a Jequitinhonha record with congener S. amblyurum.
